svg.title: Chained convolutional layers
svg.desc: The image goes into convolutional layer 1 with 6 filters, which produces 6 feature maps. These feature maps are treated as a new image and fed to convolutional layer 2, whose 12 filters each look at all 6 maps and produce 12 feature maps. A third layer can follow, and so on.
svg.text: each layer-2 filter looks at all 6 maps
